categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily engages in the research, development, production, and sales of non-standard automated intelligent assembly equipment and testing equipment. Its main products include lithium-ion battery manufacturing equipment and consumer electronics intelligent manufacturing equipment, serving sectors such as new energy, automotive electronics, consumer electronics, construction, and medical fields. Additionally, the company has expanded into consumer lithium-ion battery pack assembly through its subsidiary Shenzhen Jiayang Battery Co., Ltd.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company possesses proprietary core technologies in lithium-ion battery manufacturing equipment, including advanced battery wrapping, electrolyte injection, helium leak detection, laser measurement, and thermal pressing technologies. It employs modular design, digitalization, and intelligent manufacturing processes, integrating mechanical engineering, optics, control science, materials science, and electronics. The company also utilizes virtual simulation systems and MES integration to optimize production and quality control.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include leading lithium battery manufacturers such as CATL (Ningde Times), Sunwoda, EVE Energy, and Honeycomb Energy, as well as consumer electronics companies like Midea and Philips. The company serves markets in new energy vehicles, energy storage, consumer electronics, semiconductor, photovoltaic, and medical equipment industries. Overseas markets are growing, with orders from facilities in Hungary, Indonesia, Thailand, and India.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with headquarters and production bases in Shenzhen and Zhongshan. It has established overseas offices and subsidiaries in Italy and Hungary to support European markets and is expanding into Southeast Asia including Indonesia, Thailand, and India. The company’s products are exported globally, including to the US and Europe.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates mainly in the midstream segment of the lithium-ion battery supply chain, focusing on manufacturing equipment for battery cell assembly and testing. Through acquisition of Jiayang Battery, it has extended downstream into battery pack assembly for consumer electronics. It also provides equipment and services to upstream battery manufacturers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include enhancing core product competitiveness in high-speed wrapping and intelligent injection systems, expanding into emerging fields like semiconductor and photovoltaic equipment, and advancing global market penetration. R&D focuses on next-generation battery technologies such as quasi-solid-state, sodium-ion, and solid-state batteries, with ongoing projects in vacuum wrapping, laser welding, and automated assembly lines. The company emphasizes digital transformation and modular design to improve efficiency and product quality.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of customized non-standard automated manufacturing equipment and related accessories. The company also earns from after-sales services including equipment upgrades and maintenance. Sales are conducted mainly via direct contracts with customers, including bidding and negotiation processes.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a recognized leader in the lithium battery equipment sector, especially in battery wrapping machines, holding a top market share in this niche. Competitors include leading domestic firms such as Lead Intelligent, Yinghe Technology, Liyuanheng, Lianying Laser, Kerei Technology, and Hangke Technology. The company is positioned as a high-tech, specialized, and innovative equipment provider with strong R&D capabilities and a growing international presence.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 506 million, a 54.7% decline from the previous year, and a net loss attributable to shareholders of RMB 128 million. The decline was due to reduced equipment deliveries amid a market downturn. Despite short-term setbacks, the company’s order backlog exceeded RMB 1.3 billion by April 2025, indicating recovery potential. R&D investment increased to 10.69% of revenue, reflecting a commitment to innovation.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high-quality, reliable, and technologically advanced intelligent manufacturing solutions tailored to customer-specific processes. Its products integrate digitalization, automation, and modular design to enhance production efficiency and stability. The company’s strong R&D foundation, extensive patent portfolio, and close collaboration with leading battery manufacturers provide competitive differentiation. Additionally, its expanding global footprint and comprehensive lifecycle services offer localized support and faster delivery.
